newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgarian lev rises on mark, softens vs dollar.
newsitem.headline: Bulgarian lev rises on mark, softens vs dollar.

text.p: The Bulgarian lev firmed at 995-997 per mark at the close from 997-998 at the opening and 998-999 at Friday's close due to seasonally low foreign currency demand from banks and end-customers.
* The lev tended softer to 1,859-1,863 to the dollar from 1,858-1,863 at the opening and 1,848-1,852 at Friday's close, tracking mark/dollar on global markets.
* Local traders adjust the lev/dollar through the lev/mark and the international mark/dollar cross.
* The lev has been pegged at 1,000 to the mark as an anchor under an IMF-prescribed currency board system, a fixed exchange rate mechanism introduced on July 1 to restore confidence in the lev.
* The interbank lev/mark exchange rate may deviate by up to 0.5 percent from the currency board peg.
* Under the system the central bank pledged to buy and sell unlimited volumes of marks at 995 bid and 1,000 ask. -- Sofia Newsroom, (++359-2) 91188
